lines.text: Jesus sees a man blind from birth and says neither the man nor his parents sinned.
Jesus makes mud, puts it on the man's eyes, and sends him to wash in the Pool of Bethesda.
His parents say he is their son, born blind, but they fear the Jews, who would put believers out of the synagogue.
The Jews insult the man and say they are disciples of Abraham, because God spoke to Abraham.

wrong_details.wrong: Abraham, because God spoke to Abraham

lines.text: The Jews throw the man out, then Jesus finds him, and the man says, "Lord, I believe," and worships Him.
